verdict.rationale: Firebase documents Cloud Storage for Firebase as a product. Its Security Rules explicitly secure Cloud Storage with user-based permissions, and community feedback confirms storage rules are a real, used mechanism. However, the pack never directly documents the file upload/serve flow or any CDN-backed delivery for user files. missing for 10: explicit upload/download API documentation, CDN-backed delivery evidence, hands-on corroboration of file serving.

support.subject: As a developer, I can upload and serve user files with access rules and CDN-backed delivery

citations.quote: Use our flexible, extensible Firebase Security Rules to secure your data in Cloud Firestore, Firebase Realtime Database, and Cloud Storage.
